paragraphs.text: Tori D'Avenant is a human knight hailing from Dominaria . Tori was born into the noble D'Avenant family with a rare degenerative condition that affected members of her lineage. By her teenage years, this illness had rendered her unable to use her legs. Despite the significant challenges this posed to her training as a cavalry officer, Tori refused to be held back. With the help of a specially trained warhorse and a customized saddle designed for her needs, she leads the Avenant Fury Riders into battle. Tori has earned a reputation for her remarkable bravery and determination, facing enemy spear lines without hesitation or fear.
